verdict.rationale: Runpod is a GPU cloud platform, not an agent, so the official-MCP-server axis applies. Its docs state it provides two official MCP servers that connect AI tools and coding agents directly to Runpod. One of them manages Pods, endpoints, templates, volumes, and registries through the REST API, authenticating via Sign in with Runpod or an API key, and a probe confirms the dedicated docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP servers working, detail on the second server's scope and client setup steps.
